status: Optional vibrant-poster design recipe from a past speech-led edit; not a successfully imported third-party template or a software integration

typography.family_preference: HarmonyOS Sans SC or the current confirmed Chinese project font
typography.availability: Verify glyphs and rendering in the actual target runtime; a font installed in one environment may not exist in another

components.timing: Final timeline timebase; use frames or seconds consistently; adapt chapter count
components.motion: Completed chapters filled, future chapters gray, active cell fills by clamp((t-start)/(end-start),0,1). A separate global progress indicator is optional.
components.cell_width: Choose for label readability, not necessarily proportional to chapter duration
components.coverage: Full edited duration when requested as persistent navigation

components.motion: Brief entry, readable hold, brief exit
Paper-like card, blue/lime emphasis, short reveal
Short gathering or scale-and-settle entry; hold steadily

components.purpose: Make a spoken time or duration legible
components.motion: Compact appearance; hold across the relevant statement
components.accuracy: Do not invent a clock range from a duration or copy conflicting whiteboard times

components.purpose: Present selective homework or a similar comparison
components.motion: Reveal rows with speech; preserve reading time
Reveal one step per corresponding spoken beat

sfx_notes: Case observations only, not loudness standards. Check each source under speech. Keep independent editable audio items. BGM is not required by this recipe.
placement: Derive safe regions from actual face, gestures, whiteboard, captions and platform UI; old shot coordinates are not universal.
asset_reuse: No project IDs, fixed chapter times, source media or third-party zip are embedded. Implement with current supported editable primitives or animation components in the selected tool. This JSON is a design recipe, not a directly importable editor project.
